test_title: PYST 36: SSC GD Constable - English (Held on: 30th November 2021 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**

He was ________ by the judge for his courageous actions.
solution:
The correct answer is '**commended**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The most appropriate word for the given blank is '**commended**'.
 
• It means 'to say officially that somebody/something is very good'. (अधिकृत रूप से प्रशंसा करना; सराहना करना)
